headline: Presentations on the state of the schools and the merger process, plus appointing a merger committee representative.
summary: The meeting covers presentations on the state of the schools, the merger process and statute review, merger values, and linkage with ownership. It also includes a discussion and action item to appoint a merger committee representative.
items: Public comments: Teacher Lindsay Cox asked for board involvement in the evaluation of an administrator and raised concerns about athletics
